title: Introducing Amazon Web Services (AWS) 🌍
description: Meet the world’s most popular cloud platform.

slides.title: A Brief History 🕰️
slides.content:
# From Bookstore to Cloud Pioneer

Amazon launched AWS in 2006, born from their own need to build scalable internal systems. They realised they could sell the same infrastructure to the world.

**Key milestones**:
- 2006: S3 (Simple Storage Service) & EC2 launched.
- 2012: First AWS re:Invent conference – now the biggest cloud event.
- Today: Over 200 fully‑featured services, millions of customers, 30+ global regions.

quizData.question: In which year did AWS officially launch?
quizData.explanation: AWS went live in 2006 with S3 and EC2, revolutionising how we think about IT infrastructure.

slides.title: Global Infrastructure 🌐
slides.content:
# Regions, Availability Zones & Edge Locations

- **Region**: A physical location in the world with multiple data centres (e.g., `us-east-1`, `eu-west-1`).
- **Availability Zone (AZ)**: One or more discrete data centres within a Region, isolated from failures.
- **Edge Location**: Endpoints for caching content closer to users (CloudFront).

**Think**: Region = a city, AZs = separate buildings in that city, Edge = neighbourhood delivery lockers.

quizData.question: What is an Availability Zone?

options.text: One or more isolated data centres within a Region

quizData.explanation: Each Region has multiple AZs. They are physically separated but connected by fast, private fibre. If one AZ goes down, your apps can still run in another.

slides.title: The AWS Service Universe 🪐
slides.content:
# A Service for Everything

AWS has over 200 services, but you only need to know a handful to start:
- **Compute**: EC2, Lambda
- **Storage**: S3, EBS
- **Database**: RDS, DynamoDB
- **Networking**: VPC, Route 53
- **Security**: IAM, KMS
- **Management**: CloudWatch, CloudTrail

We’ll explore each of these throughout this course.

slides.title: Pro Tip: The AWS Free Tier 🆓
slides.content:
## Your Sandbox for Learning

AWS offers a **Free Tier** with generous limits for 12 months. You can spin up a small EC2 instance, store 5GB in S3, and more – all for $0. Perfect for this course!

Sign up at aws.amazon.com/free. We’ll set up your account next chapter.
